items.title: 360° Panoramic Cruise with Premium Tokaji Welcome Drink

pills.label: 30-Lang Audio
pills.body: 30 languages on your own phone, so bring headphones.

pills.label: Tokaji Frizzante
pills.body: a glass of premium Tokaji frizzante, or orange juice. More drinks at the bar on board.

items.pick: for 360° views from an open-air panorama deck, a guaranteed seat and a Tokaji welcome glass for €12.
items.skip: if you need step-free access: there is no wheelchair access and baby strollers are not allowed.
pros: Premium Tokaji frizzante or orange juice included
Free Wi-Fi, toilets and blankets on board
cons: Audio guide runs on your own phone
review: This is the boat to pick if the view is the whole point. The top deck is an open-air panorama deck with nothing blocking the sides, and below it sits a climate-controlled cabin with panoramic windows for colder evenings.

At €12 it costs the same as the no-frills Silverline loop but includes a welcome glass of Tokaji frizzante, a Hungarian sparkling wine, or orange juice. Every guest gets a seat, though seats are not assigned, so arrive 15 to 20 minutes early for a front spot on the top deck.
It boards at Dock 10 by Elizabeth Bridge, next to the Kisfaludy paddle steamer, with six sailings a day from 13:30 to 21:00. Pick 16:30 or later in winter to see the Parliament lit up.

items.title: Cosy Danube Cruise with Chimney Cake & Hot Winter Punch

pills.label: Winter Punch & Chimney Cake
pills.body: a mug of hot spiced pomegranate winter punch and a Cinnabon chimney cake, a crisp kürtőskalács with cinnamon-roll frosting.

items.pick: for a warm, sweet hour on the Danube on a cold evening, with hot punch and a chimney cake included.
items.skip: if you have a food allergy or intolerance: the chimney cake contains gluten and dairy and can't be changed.
pros: Hot winter punch and a Cinnabon chimney cake included
Heated cabin with a bar on board
cons: Not for food allergies, gluten or lactose intolerance
No own food or drinks on board
review: Silverline's seasonal cruise is built for cold evenings. Instead of a glass of prosecco you get a steaming mug of spiced pomegranate winter punch and a Cinnabon chimney cake: a crisp kürtőskalács, the Hungarian spit cake, topped with brown sugar, cinnamon and cream-cheese frosting.

The boat is Silverline's heated cruiser from Dock 11 by Elizabeth Bridge, with a bar for more drinks and snacks. The chimney cake is big and very sweet, so two people can share one and add a second punch instead.

It runs five times an evening, from 15:30 to 21:00. Take the 15:30 or 17:00 sailing for sunset and the city lights coming on. The cake has a fixed recipe with gluten and dairy, so skip it with an allergy or intolerance.

items.title: Unlimited Mulled Wine Cruise on the Danube

pills.label: Unlimited Mulled Wine
pills.body: 4 red mulled wines (classic orange, pomegranate & cardamom, apple & ginger, cranberry & orange) and a white pear & vanilla mulled wine, plus 2 alcohol-free winter punches.

items.pick: for an hour of unlimited hot mulled wine on a heated boat, the warmest way to see the lights in winter.
items.skip: if you are under 18 and want the wine: alcohol is only served from 18, the punches are alcohol-free.
cons: No own food or drinks on board
review: This is Silverline's winter answer to the prosecco cruise: an hour of unlimited mulled wine instead of bubbles. You choose from four red versions (classic orange, pomegranate and cardamom, apple and ginger, cranberry and orange) and a white pear and vanilla one, refilled as often as you like.

Non-drinkers and kids are not left out: there are two alcohol-free winter punches, apple and pomegranate, and alcohol is only served from 18. The heated cabin has big windows, so you stay warm and still see the Parliament and the Castle.
It leaves from Silverline's Dock 11 by Elizabeth Bridge at 16:30, 18:00, 19:30 and 21:00. The 16:30 sailing catches sunset turning into city lights in late autumn.
facts: Silverline Cruises, Dock 11, Jane Haining rakpart, by Elizabeth Bridge (Pest side)

items.title: Night Cruise with 3 Drinks and a Live Folk & Operetta Show

pills.label: 19:00 · 2 h 15 min
pills.body: on selected evenings, for about 2 hours 15 minutes. Prices vary by day.

pills.label: 3 Drinks Included
pills.body: cocktails and classics from the bar's set list, or mocktails if you don't drink alcohol.

pills.label: Live Folk & Operetta
pills.body: a Hungarian string quartet plays folk music and operetta favourites through the evening.

items.pick: for a long, cultural night on the river: 3 drinks and a live Hungarian string quartet without paying for dinner.
items.skip: if you want food: dinner is not included, and a window table costs €25 more per person.
pros: Live Hungarian string quartet, folk and operetta
2 h 15 min, the longest non-dinner cruise here
review: This is the Silverline evening built around music rather than food. A Hungarian string quartet plays folk tunes and operetta classics while the boat makes a slow 2 hour 15 minute loop past the lit-up Parliament and Castle.

Three drinks per person are included: cocktails and classics from a set list, or mocktails if you skip alcohol. Dinner is not part of it, so it costs far less than a dinner cruise with the same show. A window table is €25 extra per person.
It departs at 19:00 from Dock 11 by Elizabeth Bridge, on selected evenings only, and prices change by day. Arrive 20 minutes early for check-in.
